records.name: Moneda

No custody risk, no lock-ups, no complexity. This launch introduces Neo Finance: self-owned money that works across borders and feels as simple as a bank without being one.

records.name: Waymark

Unlike many Bible and devotional apps that focus on volume or streaks, Waymark takes a calmer, product-led approach centered on clarity, reflection, and emotional safety.

Built without heavy frameworks or third-party dependencies, BellaVista offers a lightweight, modular foundation that can be extended, customized, and monetized by its owner.

records.name: Pixel Arcade Studio

records.name: kuku

Obsidian + Cursor, without Electron.

records.name: GetDigest: Read less, understand more.

Join our Open Alpha!

records.name: TalkMirror
records.tagline: Instant voice mirror & speech pacing. Privacy-first.
records.description: TalkMirror is an acoustic mirror for your voice.
